observed_failures: Strict voxel IoU failed at 0.820341 despite low normalized chamfer and close volume, indicating substantial distributed shape mismatch rather than a broken solid.
Bounding-box relative error failed: candidate axial extent is 27.21 mm versus 28.025217 mm for the evaluated reference.
Localized candidate-excess regions repeat around the tooth perimeter on the sprocket side faces and link primarily to op_outer_02/op_hub_02.
The reference contains radial-hole cylindrical surfaces of radius 2.5 mm, while op_m6_01 created radius 3.0 mm surfaces.
root_causes: The tooth outline was an ad hoc cosine/polyline approximation rather than the circular roller-pocket and flank geometry of a 24-tooth 08B sprocket.
The visible 1.65 mm chamfers on both tooth sides were omitted, leaving excess planar tooth-end surfaces around the perimeter.
The inferred hub length was too short; the evaluated extent supports a nominal 28 mm overall axial length rather than 27.21 mm.
The M6 feature was modeled at nominal thread diameter Ø6 instead of the Ø5 tapping-drill diameter represented by the reference cylindrical surfaces.
reflection.structure_assessment: The candidate is structurally healthy: one watertight native 3DSOLID, successful Boolean lineage, valid export, and volume error of only 0.2841%. Bore, keyway, and general hub/sprocket organization should be retained. Repair should focus on the inherited outer-profile/end-face geometry, the hub axial extent, and the op_m6_01 cut diameter; there is no evidence of an MCP, verifier, or artifact failure.
reflection.decision_reason: A further iteration is strongly justified because the feedback identifies three concrete, reference-consistent corrections: rebuild the 08B tooth contour, add the explicitly dimensioned 1.65 mm bilateral tooth chamfers, and correct the hub and tapped-hole sizes. These changes directly address the failed IoU and bounding-box checks while preserving the already-correct watertight structure and volume.
planned_geometry_changes: Rebuild the 24-tooth outer profile using the drawing's R51.50 tip envelope and Ø96.93 pitch geometry with standard 08B roller-pocket arcs, replacing the cosine radial approximation.
Form the tooth region with 1.65 mm chamfers from both axial sides, retaining a 3.91 mm central tooth land within the 7.21 mm width.
Increase overall hub axial length from 27.21 mm to nominal 28.00 mm, keeping the sprocket width at 7.21 mm and adjusting the rear projection to 20.79 mm.
Replace the radial M6 Ø6 cut with a Ø5 tapping-drill cut at the same 8 mm axial location.
Retain the Ø60 hub, Ø30 bore, 8 mm keyway, 33.3 mm keyway-height dimension, and single-solid Boolean structure.

public_events.text: The drawing resolves the main geometry as a 24-tooth 08B sprocket with a 7.21 mm tooth width, Ø60 hub, Ø30 H7 bore, 8 mm keyway, and R51.50 tooth-tip radius. I’m building it in recoverable stages: outer sprocket/hub first, then bore and keyway, then the radial M6 hole. The hub’s overall axial projection is not numerically stated, so I’m matching the section’s stated geometry with a 20 mm rear projection plus the 7.21 mm sprocket width.

arguments.lisp:
(setvar "CMDECHO" 0)
(setvar "FACETRES" 10)
(setq pts '())
(setq z 24 n 16 rroot 44.21 rtip 51.50 i 0)
(repeat (* z n)
  (setq ang (* 2.0 pi (/ i (* z n))))
  (setq u (- (/ (rem i n) (float n)) 0.5))
  (setq au (abs u))
  (if (<= au 0.34)
    (setq rr (+ rroot (* (- rtip rroot) (expt (cos (* pi (/ au 0.68))) 0.72))))
    (setq rr rroot))
  (setq pts (append pts (list (list (* rr (cos ang)) (* rr (sin ang))))))
  (setq i (1+ i)))
(entmake (append (list '(0 . "LWPOLYLINE") '(100 . "AcDbEntity") '(8 . "0") '(100 . "AcDbPolyline") (cons 90 (length pts)) '(70 . 1))
                 (mapcar '(lambda (p) (cons 10 p)) pts)))
(setq pl (entlast))
(command "_.REGION" pl "")
(setq reg (entlast))
(command "_.EXTRUDE" reg "" 7.21 0)
(setq gear (entlast))
(command "_.CYLINDER" '(0 0 -20.0) 30.0 27.21)
(setq hub (entlast))
(command "_.UNION" gear hub "")
(setq final (entlast))
(setq solids (ssget "_X" '((0 . "3DSOLID"))))
(if (/= (sslength solids) 1) (progn (princ "\nERROR_OUTER_SOLID_COUNT") (quit)))
(command "_.ZOOM" "_E")
(princ "\nSTAGE1_OK_ONE_3DSOLID")
(princ)

public_events.text: The first isolated build did not produce an artifact, so I’m retrying the outer-body stage with a simpler, more robust solid-construction sequence while keeping the same dimensions and provenance breakdown. No downstream feature cuts have been attempted yet.

arguments.lisp:
(setvar "CMDECHO" 0)
(setq toothCount 24 samples 12 rootR 44.21 tipR 51.5 idx 0 vertices nil)
(repeat (* toothCount samples)
 (setq theta (* 2.0 pi (/ idx (float (* toothCount samples)))))
 (setq frac (- (/ (rem idx samples) (float samples)) 0.5))
 (setq af (abs frac))
 (if (< af 0.333333)
   (setq rad (+ rootR (* (- tipR rootR) (cos (* 1.5 pi af)))))
   (setq rad rootR))
 (setq vertices (cons (list (* rad (cos theta)) (* rad (sin theta))) vertices))
 (setq idx (+ idx 1)))
(setq vertices (reverse vertices))
(setq dxf (list '(0 . "LWPOLYLINE") '(100 . "AcDbEntity") '(8 . "0") '(100 . "AcDbPolyline") (cons 90 (length vertices)) '(70 . 1)))
(foreach p vertices (setq dxf (append dxf (list (cons 10 p)))))
(entmake dxf)
(setq outline (entlast))
(command-s "_.REGION" outline "")
(setq profile (entlast))
(command-s "_.EXTRUDE" profile "" "7.21" "0")
(setq sprocket (entlast))
(command-s "_.CYLINDER" '(0.0 0.0 -20.0) "30.0" "27.21")
(setq hub (entlast))
(command-s "_.UNION" sprocket hub "")
(princ "\nOUTER_BODY_COMPLETE")
(princ)

(setvar "CMDECHO" 0)
(setvar "DELOBJ" 1)
(command-s "_.ERASE" "_ALL" "")
(setq pitchR 48.465 rollerR 4.255 tipR 51.5 rootR 44.21
      halfPitch (/ pi 24.0) fullPitch (/ pi 12.0)
      qx 46.166207474487706 qy 3.5805834614834477)
(setq nx (/ (- pitchR qx) rollerR))
(setq ny (/ (- qy) rollerR))
(setq lineC (+ (* nx qx) (* ny qy)))
(setq ndotTip (+ (* nx (cos halfPitch)) (* ny (sin halfPitch))))
(setq circleDelta (- (atan qy (- qx pitchR)) pi))
(setq arcBulge (tan (/ circleDelta 4.0)))
(defun rotpt (x y a)
  (list (- (* x (cos a)) (* y (sin a)))
        (+ (* x (sin a)) (* y (cos a)))))
(defun makeprof (off elev / rr sc oqx oqy otr verts k base p dxf)
  (setq rr (+ rollerR off))
